_comment: Per-rule verification join generated by scripts/rule_verification.py. Each rule row carries genuine per-rule grounding + manifest-provenance flags and a SURFACE-level oracle-coverage flag (surface_oracle / surface_executable) sourced from coverage_overview.json. surface_oracle means the rule's program surface is exercised by a live comparison; it is a lower bound on verification, not a per-rule proof. See rule_verification_summary.json for the tracked KPI.
